title: Undertale Intro Boom
blurb: Toby Fox opens Undertale with a single deep impact, and it does more work than most games manage with a full orchestra. That is characteristic of the whole soundtrack — sparse, deliberate, built in a tracker by one person who knew exactly what each sound was for. The boom sets the tone before you have seen anything: something old, something serious, something that will remember what you did. Play it before dramatic reveals, or to lend an ordinary announcement the weight of an ending you cannot undo.
origin: The intro impact from Undertale (Toby Fox).
